title: Chemically Informed Coarse-Graining of Electrostatic Forces in Charge-Rich Biomolecular Condensates.
authors: R Tejedor, Andres; Aguirre Gonzalez, Anne; Maristany, M Julia; Chew, Pin Yu; Russell, Kieran; Ramirez, Jorge; Espinosa, Jorge R; Collepardo-Guevara, Rosana
one_liner_zh: 该文提出化学信息增强的粗粒化模型Mpipi-Recharged，通过非对称Yukawa静电势改进电荷富集生物分子凝聚体（含无序蛋白/RNA）的静电相互作用描述，并用于预测相行为与机制，对象、互作（凝聚体PPI环境）与物理模拟方法三者齐备且具机制深度。
abstract: Biomolecular condensates composed of highly charged biomolecules, such as DNA, RNA, chromatin, and nucleic-acid binding proteins, are ubiquitous in the cell nucleus. The biophysical properties of these charge-rich condensates are largely regulated by electrostatic interactions. Residue-resolution coarse-grained models that describe solvent and ions implicitly are widely used to gain mechanistic insights into the biophysical properties of condensates, offering transferability, computational efficiency, and accurate predictions for multiple systems. However, their predictive accuracy diminishes for charge-rich condensates due to the implicit treatment of solvent and ions. Here, we present Mpipi-Recharged, a residue-resolution coarse-grained model that improves the description of charge effects in biomolecular condensates containing disordered proteins, multidomain proteins, and/or disordered single-stranded RNAs. Mpipi-Recharged introduces a pair-specific asymmetric Yukawa electrostatic potential, informed by atomistic simulations. We show that this asymmetric coarse-graining of electrostatic forces captures intricate effects, such as charge blockiness, stoichiometry variations in complex coacervates, and modulation of salt concentration, without requiring explicit solvation. Mpipi-Recharged provides excellent agreement with experiments in predicting the phase behavior of highly charged condensates. Overall, Mpipi-Recharged improves the computational tools available to investigate the physicochemical mechanisms regulating biomolecular condensates, enhancing the scope of computer simulations in this field.
abstract_zh: 由高度带电的生物分子（如DNA、RNA、染色质和核酸结合蛋白）组成的生物分子凝聚体在细胞核中普遍存在。这些富含电荷的凝聚体的生物物理性质主要受静电相互作用调控。描述溶剂和离子隐式处理的残基分辨率粗粒化模型被广泛用于获取凝聚体生物物理性质的机制性见解，具有可转移性、计算效率高，并能对多种系统进行准确预测。然而，由于溶剂和离子的隐式处理，这些模型对富含电荷的凝聚体的预测准确性会降低。在此，我们提出Mpipi-Recharged，一种残基分辨率粗粒化模型，改进了对含有无序蛋白、多结构域蛋白和/或无序单链RNA的生物分子凝聚体中电荷效应的描述。Mpipi-Recharged引入了一种由原子模拟指导的配对特异性非对称Yukawa静电势。我们表明，这种静电力的非对称粗粒化处理能够捕捉复杂效应，如电荷块状性、复合凝聚层中化学计量比的变化以及盐浓度的调节，而无需显式溶剂化。Mpipi-Recharged在预测高电荷凝聚体的相行为方面与实验高度一致。总体而言，Mpipi-Recharged改进了用于研究调控生物分子凝聚体的物理化学机制的计算工具，扩展了该领域计算机模拟的应用范围。
